body.statement: If \(\Delta_j\ge0\) for every active \(j=(C,s)\in J\), then \(\rho^{\star}=1-\rho_0\) is the unique maximizing holdout fraction for the full-cell conditional-power objective. At that fraction every binding cell has an optimal weight in \([\theta_{0j},\pi/2)\), with equality to \(\theta_{0j}\) exactly when \(\Delta_j=0\); slack-cell weights are the full superlevel sets required by \(\mathcal{S}^{\star}\).
body.justification: This gives a closed-form and unique holdout decision on a nondegenerate primitive region.
body.gap: Existing enrichment optimization gives numerical policies; no source derives a primitive sign condition forcing the maximal information-preserving holdout.
body.consumer: A FOURIER-style design whose pilot primitives satisfy the sign certificate can choose the largest permitted holdout without global numerical search.
